title: The Great Ace Attorney 2: Resolve
subtitle: The defence returns to an unfinished case
summary: The Great Ace Attorney 2: Resolve is Capcom's Nintendo 3DS courtroom adventure continuing Ryunosuke Naruhodo's story in Japan and Britain. Following the first game's unresolved questions, it brings the returning defence team into cases whose connections extend beyond an individual hearing. Susato Mikotoba and Herlock Sholmes remain central companions as the investigation develops. The sequel gives the historical setting a longer narrative structure, allowing details introduced in earlier encounters to acquire new significance when another witness, piece of evidence or account changes what they appeared to mean.
body: The Great Ace Attorney 2: Resolve is Capcom's Nintendo 3DS courtroom adventure continuing Ryunosuke Naruhodo's story in Japan and Britain. Following the first game's unresolved questions, it brings the returning defence team into cases whose connections extend beyond an individual hearing. Susato Mikotoba and Herlock Sholmes remain central companions as the investigation develops. The sequel gives the historical setting a longer narrative structure, allowing details introduced in earlier encounters to acquire new significance when another witness, piece of evidence or account changes what they appeared to mean.

Cross-examinations can place several witnesses together, allowing one person's testimony to provoke a response from another. The player watches those reactions and follows them into further questions, comparing accounts rather than treating each speaker as an isolated source. Evidence still provides the means to challenge a contradiction. The group arrangement adds another reason to pay attention between formal statements: hesitation or surprise may indicate that someone knows more than the current testimony admits. Understanding the relationship between witnesses becomes part of understanding the event they describe.

Dance of Deduction sequences again require Ryunosuke to correct Sholmes's reasoning by examining the details around him. British hearings also retain Summation Examination, where conflicting reasons offered by jurors can be set against one another. These systems provide several routes into the same task of testing an explanation. Resolve uses the returning methods across a story designed to conclude the pair of adventures. The familiar gestures gain weight because a newly established fact can affect an older mystery, giving careful observation consequences beyond the immediate courtroom exchange.
